projects.title: Legal Mind RAG — Samvidhan AI
projects.tagline: AI legal assistant for the Indian Constitution
projects.description: AI-powered legal assistant that answers questions about the Indian Constitution and legal documents using Retrieval-Augmented Generation. Built a hybrid retrieval pipeline combining dense vector search, BM25 sparse retrieval, and Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF), with FastAPI and Ollama powering the application layer.

caseStudy.problem: Legal professionals and citizens struggle to quickly find relevant clauses in the lengthy Indian Constitution and related legal documents.
caseStudy.solution: Designed a hybrid RAG system that combines dense vector search (semantic) with BM25 (lexical) retrieval, then fuses results via Reciprocal Rank Fusion for high-precision context selection.
caseStudy.impact: Significantly improved answer relevance over single-retriever baselines; demonstrated production-grade RAG architecture using local LLMs via Ollama.
highlights: Local LLM inference via Ollama (no cloud cost)
FastAPI service with clean REST contract

projects.title: Fake News Detection System
projects.description: Deep learning-based fake news detection system trained on 72,000+ news articles using a hybrid BERT and BiLSTM architecture with TF-IDF, POS-tagging, and sentiment features. Includes attention-based explainability, FastAPI inference, Docker deployment, and visual heatmaps for model predictions.

caseStudy.problem: Misinformation spreads faster than manual fact-checking can counter, and pure black-box models lack the explainability needed for trust.
caseStudy.solution: Built a hybrid BERT + BiLSTM classifier with hand-crafted linguistic features (TF-IDF, POS, sentiment) and attention-based interpretability that highlights the tokens driving each prediction.
caseStudy.impact: Trained on 72k+ articles; packaged with FastAPI inference, Docker, and visual heatmaps so end-users can see why a claim was flagged.

projects.title: ShopWave — Autonomous Support Agent
projects.description: Autonomous e-commerce customer-support resolution system that classifies support tickets, executes multi-step tool chains, validates actions, escalates uncertain cases, and maintains a complete audit trail.

caseStudy.problem: E-commerce support tickets overwhelm human teams, and naive chatbots can't execute multi-step actions safely.
caseStudy.solution: Built an autonomous agent that classifies intent, executes validated tool chains, escalates low-confidence cases, and logs every step for audit.
caseStudy.impact: Demonstrated a production-style agent loop with fault tolerance and human-in-the-loop escalation.
highlights: Full audit trail of every action

projects.title: Gemini OCR — Azure
projects.description: AI-powered OCR application that extracts text from images and PDF documents using Google Gemini's multimodal capabilities. Built a serverless Python backend with Azure Functions.

caseStudy.problem: Traditional OCR struggles with noisy images and PDFs that mix text with charts, tables, and diagrams.
caseStudy.solution: Leveraged Gemini's multimodal capabilities through a serverless Azure Functions backend, so documents are parsed on demand with no infrastructure to manage.
caseStudy.impact: Clean, event-driven OCR pipeline that scales with usage and costs nothing when idle.

projects.title: Solar Power Generation Forecasting
projects.description: Machine learning system for forecasting solar power generation using historical power data, weather information, and temporal features. Deployed the prediction workflow through Streamlit.

caseStudy.problem: Solar power generation is highly weather-dependent, making grid planning and storage hard.
caseStudy.solution: Built regression + ensemble models combining historical generation, weather, and temporal features; deployed via Streamlit for easy exploration.
caseStudy.impact: An interactive forecasting tool that helps plan renewable-energy operations more reliably.

projects.title: Kaggle Backpack Price Prediction
projects.description: Machine learning regression project developed for the Kaggle Tabular Playground Series to predict backpack prices from product attributes. Performed EDA, feature engineering, and RMSE evaluation.

caseStudy.problem: Kaggle tabular challenge: predict backpack prices from product attributes.
caseStudy.solution: End-to-end EDA, feature engineering, and RMSE-driven model selection.
caseStudy.impact: Strong baseline submission with a clean, reusable pipeline.

projects.title: AI Traffic Congestion Analysis
projects.description: Computer vision and deep learning system for analyzing traffic footage to identify congestion levels and forecast traffic flow. Uses video-based visual analysis to extract traffic patterns.

caseStudy.problem: Manual traffic monitoring doesn't scale and misses short-term patterns.
caseStudy.solution: Video-based CV pipeline that classifies congestion levels and forecasts near-term flow.
caseStudy.impact: Pattern-level insight from raw traffic footage for city planners.

projects.title: Public Transport Delay × Weather
projects.description: Data analysis pipeline combining public transport delay data with weather events to identify disruption patterns and relationships between environmental conditions and transportation performance.

caseStudy.problem: Transit agencies need to understand how weather drives delays.
caseStudy.solution: Joined public transport delay records with weather events and surfaced disruption patterns.
caseStudy.impact: Clear, reproducible analysis showing environmental drivers of delay.

projects.title: HitCast — Spotify Popularity Predictor
projects.description: Machine learning system that predicts Spotify track popularity using audio characteristics and regression techniques. Performed data preparation, feature analysis, and predictive modeling.

caseStudy.problem: Can audio features alone predict whether a track will become popular?
caseStudy.solution: Built a regression pipeline on Spotify audio features with feature analysis.
caseStudy.impact: Insights into which acoustic features correlate with popularity.

projects.title: OCR Studio
projects.description: Offline OCR web application that converts images into structured JSON entirely on the client side. Built with React and Tesseract to perform text extraction without cloud-based OCR services.

caseStudy.problem: Cloud OCR services are expensive and risky for sensitive documents.
caseStudy.solution: Pure client-side React + Tesseract pipeline that converts images to structured JSON in the browser.
caseStudy.impact: Zero-cost, fully private OCR that works offline.

projects.title: Loan Dataset Analysis
projects.description: End-to-end exploratory analysis of loan data, including missing-value treatment, IQR-based outlier handling, statistical analysis, and univariate, bivariate, and multivariate visualization.

caseStudy.problem: Raw loan datasets need rigorous cleaning before they tell a story.
caseStudy.solution: Missing-value treatment, IQR outlier handling, and multi-level visualization.
caseStudy.impact: Clean, reproducible analysis with a reusable notebook.

projects.title: HRMS — Backend & Frontend
projects.description: Full-stack Human Resource Management System covering employee, payroll, and attendance workflows through a React frontend, RESTful backend services, and MongoDB-based data management.

caseStudy.problem: Small teams need a lightweight HR system without enterprise bloat.
caseStudy.solution: Modular full-stack build: React frontend, REST backend, MongoDB persistence.
caseStudy.impact: Covers employee, payroll, and attendance in a clean, maintainable codebase.

projects.title: UMS Replica
projects.description: Full-stack University Management System replica with modules for students, faculty, courses, and administrative workflows. Developed a responsive React frontend integrated with MongoDB.

caseStudy.problem: Universities need unified tooling across students, faculty, and admin.
caseStudy.solution: Responsive React frontend with MongoDB-backed modules for each persona.
caseStudy.impact: A reusable UMS foundation that can be extended per institution.
